(a)       In the prior year, net impairment losses on financial and contract assets were included in other expenses in the condensed consolidated statements of profit or (loss).
         Under the current year presentation, this has been restated and presented separately, resulting in the other expenses in the condensed consolidated statements of profit
         or (loss) for the three months ended 30 September 2024 decreasing by £50.5 million from £623.5 million to £573.0 million and for the nine months ended 30 September
         2024 decreasing by £158.4 million from £1,848.8 million to £1,690.4 million.
